chapter: Childhood, Mardi Gras and first brass band
title: Childhood neighborhood and first school
summary: Raised indoors near Semperm, he attended a private Catholic school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Charlie McCurtis. What were the very first bands you heard when you were a boy, even parade bands and brass bands in the street? Do you remember any parades when you were real young, just a little kid, say maybe six or seven years old?
Well, when I was real young, I was a kid that didn't let go around the street. They kept me inside.
Yeah, a lot of children didn't.
And I was brought to play in my yard.
You told us where you were raised, what part of town was it, right around here was it?
Yes, that's not far from me, it's Semperm.
Yes. Which school did you go to, by the way? I usually forget to ask people where they went to school or anything about their childhood.

My first school was a private school, just about, just a block and a half from where I was living. Because after I was born and grew up big enough to go to school, we was living on the island between Johnson and Galvis. Was it one of the Catholic schools? Yes. That was the first school I went to, Miss Angelina Barnerys.
